pages.title: Install MajesticTab
pages.desc: Install MajesticTab on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Android, Linux or Steam Deck.

pages.title: Open your first tab
pages.desc: Play a tab, and then add it to your library.

pages.title: Your library
pages.desc: Organize tabs by artist, album and song. Pin songs and reopen recent tabs.

pages.title: Setlists and tunings
pages.desc: Create setlists and browse your library by tuning.

pages.title: Getting tabs in
pages.desc: Open files from your device or cloud storage, search the web for tabs, import a folder or browse classical tabs.

pages.title: Backup and sync
pages.desc: Back up your library to one .mtbackup file, or sync it through Google Drive, S3, WebDAV or iCloud.

pages.title: The reader
pages.desc: Learn the five reader controls, the song menu, the playback dock and Reading mode.

pages.title: View
pages.desc: Choose the layout, notation, size, paper and tracks of a score.

pages.title: Practice
pages.desc: Change the speed, loop bars, use the metronome and count-in, and choose which parts play.

pages.title: Sound
pages.desc: Use the built-in synth, the mixer and SoundFonts, and compensate for audio latency.

pages.title: Original recording
pages.desc: Map a tab to a YouTube video or an audio file by tapping along.

pages.title: Fit a tab to your guitar
pages.desc: Show a tab on 6, 7 or 8 strings, and match your tuning, capo or transposition.

pages.title: Fretboard and the Tools menu
pages.desc: Show the fretboard and open the reference and practice tools from the reader.

pages.title: PDF and text tabs
pages.desc: Condense PDFs, bookmark pages, split a book into songs and read text tabs.

pages.title: Jam sessions
pages.desc: Host or join a Jam on your local network so every player is on the same bar.

pages.title: The Tools view
pages.desc: Find the reference, practice, tab and library tools in one list.

pages.title: Chord library
pages.desc: Look up chord voicings that match your strings, tuning and capo.

pages.title: Scales
pages.desc: Show a scale or mode on the fretboard.

pages.title: Circle of fifths
pages.desc: Look up a key, its signature, its relative minor and its chords.

pages.title: Tuner
pages.desc: Tune your guitar with the microphone.

pages.title: Metronome
pages.desc: Keep time with tap tempo, time signatures and a visual click.

pages.title: Make backing tracks
pages.desc: Remove the guitar from your audio files with StemDeck and save the result as a backing track.

pages.title: Open file
pages.desc: Play a tab without adding it to your library.

pages.title: Classical tab browser
pages.desc: Search and open classical guitar tabs and MIDI files.

pages.title: Fill in missing tabs
pages.desc: Search the web for a tab of each song that has none.

pages.title: Bulk import
pages.desc: Import a folder of tabs or audio files and pair each file with a song.

pages.title: Bulk export
pages.desc: Export your library as a spreadsheet, map data, tab files or PDFs.

pages.title: Keyboard shortcuts
pages.desc: Look up the keyboard and mouse shortcuts for the reader and the library.

pages.title: Foot pedals and game controllers
pages.desc: Turn pages and control playback with a Bluetooth foot pedal or a game controller.

pages.title: Settings
pages.desc: Set the theme, defaults, updates and data options.

pages.title: Supported files
pages.desc: See which file types MajesticTab opens and creates.

pages.title: Troubleshooting and questions
pages.desc: Find answers to common questions and fixes for common problems.
